title: Field Destruction Order
goal: Arrange struct fields to match expected destruction order.
hints: Struct fields drop in top-to-bottom declaration order.
Match field names with their expected types in the struct body.
explanation: Struct fields drop in declaration order (top to bottom). Declaring `a: FieldA` first and `b: FieldB` second causes `FieldA` to drop first (1) and `FieldB` second (2), yielding 12. Swapping the field names causes a type mismatch `E0308` during initialization. Duplicate field names fail with `E0124`.
